sonnet.problem: This story card retells that the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance. That is the right answer to the choice card just before it (card 7). It also repeats the point of that card instead of moving the passage forward.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The question gives the first half of the verse, "In those days there was no king in Israel," and asks the baker to supply the rest. That is guessing the next words of a line. This passage hasn't shown the refrain, so the baker can't reason it out.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
